name: modes
description: How a session works with you and with its subagents. Two session modes, each [on|off|status] (/orchestrate also lead), answered with no model call, Claude told once at each switch and reminded by one line on each prompt while on, a label in the prompt footer: /orchestrate hands independent parts to subagents, a fresh agent on haiku · sonnet · opus when the brief stands alone or a fork when the part needs the conversation, and at lead the main session plans and decides while agents do the work; /ask answers and changes nothing, refusing Edit, Write and NotebookEdit while on. /modes:interview asks you rounds of AskUserQuestion until the direction is clear. /modes:align stops work in progress: it plays back what was built, names where it drifted from what you asked, and asks before any more changes. A Claude Mod: needs CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_FUNCTION_HOOKS=1.

setup.summary: session modes: /ask changes nothing, /orchestrate hands work to subagents
gives: /ask on|off — answers only; Edit and Write are refused while it is on
/orchestrate on|lead|off — on: independent parts go to subagents on haiku, sonnet or opus; lead: agents do the work, the session plans and decides
/modes:interview and /modes:align — agree on the direction before and during the work
